testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate between a file's folder and its parent ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved part with a preview is selected in a child folder ✔ And the dialog starts in `fixtures/cad/document-opening/folder-navigation/NativeParent/NativeChild` with `Navigation-Part.opd` selected ✔ When the user chooses Up to the parent folder ✔ Then the parent folder contents are displayed ✔ And the child folder is highlighted in the list ✔ And the file name field retains the part name ✔ And the preview area shows a placeholder for the selected folder ✔ When the user chooses Back ✔ Then the child folder contents are displayed again ✔ And the file name field and preview display the previously selected part ✔ When the user chooses Forward ✔ Then the parent folder contents are displayed again ✔ And the child folder is highlighted
